LESSON: When a scope-expansion card says 'run the proven job unchanged,' still check whether the default (no-filter) execution mode matches the card's actual scope -- R5B's job defaults to 'all in-scope cities' now that the exclusion list is empty, which is correct behavior for the job itself but not the efficient way to execute THIS card's specific five-city authorization. The --city flag existed from R5's own design for exactly this kind of targeted re-run; use it.

A gated UPDATE (WHERE cell_state->>'kind'='unaccounted') makes an accidental full re-run safe, not free -- cancelling and rescoping saved real wall-clock and store-scan cost even though no data integrity was ever at risk.
